recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If diagrams are regenerated through the normal build, the SVG should be updated from the authoritative StructureDefinition wording; no manual source change is needed for FHIR-48836.
issue_request: FHIR-48836 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by Vocabulary. It requested changing CodeSystem.concept.property.code from a strict reference to CodeSystem.property.code to a reference to CodeSystem.property.code or a code from http://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties when there is no corresponding CodeSystem.property.code.
initial_application: Grahame Grieve's 62807b712b3f300935ff60ebdfc6bdc5ef78daaa source commit applied FHIR-48836 by changing the short and definition in source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml. Earlier, FHIR-41678 had added supporting CodeSystem narrative guidance about reserving and inferring defined concept-properties codes.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes codesystem=CodeSystem in [resources] and concept-properties=codesystem\codesystem-concept-properties.xml in [codesystems]. The originating Zulip thread shows the validator error and the request for a Vocabulary-approved R6 change; Vocabulary's 2025-07-28 minutes record FHIR-48836 as RESOLVED CHANGE REQUIRED. A stale strict sentence remains in source/codesystem/codesystem.svg, but that is a generated-looking diagram artifact rather than the authoritative source.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current build-scope StructureDefinition and related narrative already convey the approved allowance, and editing only the stale SVG would violate the generated-artifact guardrail.
